name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

eligibility.other_conditions: Must be an adult woman belonging to a BPL, SC/ST, PMAY, or poor household. No existing LPG connection in the family.

benefits: Free LPG gas connection with deposit-free cylinder, pressure regulator, and safety hose. First refill and stove provided free of cost, plus ongoing targeted subsidy of Rs. 300 per cylinder for up to 12 refills/year.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of adult female applicant
Ration Card or BPL Certificate showing family composition
Declaration of no existing LPG connection
application_process: Submit simplified KYC form online or at nearest LPG distributor (Indane, BharatGas, HP Gas).
Distributor validates family deduplication across national OMC database.
Issue of gas connection voucher and delivery of cylinder.
